sources.title: Elesclomol-copper therapy improves neurodevelopment in two children with Menkes disease
sources.access_scope: Full public PMC article retrieved; used here only to identify the exact prior P010 article and distinguish it from CuNC. No new clinical efficacy adjudication or patient count is added.
sources.original_paraphrase: The historical P010 source describes elesclomol-copper treatment in two children. It is a copper-ionophore article, not the histidine/acetate copper nanocluster formulation.
sources.decision_limits: Prior same-disease therapeutic concept, different exact article. Human observations remain part of the historical source lineage and are not CuNC evidence. The article predates the 2026 FDA approval; its historical no-approved-treatment statement is not current comparator guidance.
